# nb-studio inbox

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## inbox delete

Delete a message from the inbox

Reads and changes only the signed-in user's inbox; another user's message answers 404.

```bash
nb-studio inbox delete <message>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `message` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                   |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this message from the inbox?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/notificationInApp/messages/{messageId}` (`notificationInAppDeleteMessage`)

## inbox list

List the caller’s inbox

Decisions waiting on the caller and news, newest first, with what each is about. An agent’s run reads the inbox of the person who woke it.

```bash
nb-studio inbox list
```

| Flag           | Type    | Description        |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------------ |
| `--unread`     | boolean | Only unread items. |
| `--limit`      | integer | (default 20)       |
| `--page-token` | string  |                    |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `kind`, `pending`, `issue`, `title`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `studio.inbox/read`.

**Request:** `GET /api/inbox/items` (`inboxListItems`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio inbox list --unread true
```

Reads and changes only the signed-in user's inbox; another user's message answers 404.


**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

## inbox waiting

List the decisions waiting on the caller

Newest first, with their in-app items; `subject=<type>:<id>` keeps those about one thing.

```bash
nb-studio inbox waiting
```

| Flag        | Type   | Description |
| ----------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `--subject` | string |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `item.id`, `notice.type`, `notice.subject.label`, `item.title`, `item.createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/inbox/waiting` (`inboxListWaiting`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio inbox waiting --subject issue:123
```
